Package hadur2.core.world

Class Roster

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.world.Roster
public final class Roster extends Object
The World's teammates and its count of enemies alive (A5): who is on our team, where each was last known to be and since when, who is known or presumed dead, and from the enemies' deaths a count that never falls below the truth (WORLD-3, WORLD-8). Empty off a team.

A teammate is never in the EnemyTracker: nothing a strand reads holds one.

  • Field Details

    • SILENT_WINDOW

      public static final long SILENT_WINDOW
      WORLD-3: a teammate silent this many ticks while the engine's count of others has fallen is counted dead. Reports arrive every tick, so this is a run of skipped turns long enough to be a death the engine's event did not reach us.

    • reported

      public void reported(String name, long tick, double x, double y, double heading, double velocity, int othersNow)
      WORLD-4, WORLD-8: a report from name stating tick, with its position. A report proves its sender alive; one stating the tick before is a hearing on this one. A report stating a tick no later than the sender's known death (its last, read with the death) places it and nothing more: the dead stay dead.
